title: onprem: airgap offline bundle - vendor RKE2 + Flatcar support, vendored images and checksum manifest
author: Priya Kumar
description: Context: Customers running private/on-prem deployments on vendor Kubernetes distributions (RKE2) and immutable host OSes (Flatcar) need an air-gapped offline bundle that includes vetted images, OS-specific manifests, and deterministic checksums. This PR: 1) extends the offline bundle generator to vendor RKE2-compatible manifests and Flatcar/containerd variants; 2) vendors required OCI images (cert-manager, contour, metrics-server, openvarnish) into the bundle with a checksums.json manifest; 3) updates Helm charts (redwood-private) to support containerd imagePullSecrets and CRI detection; 4) tightens the bundle allowlist to reduce size and adds gzip+sha256 packaging; 5) adds verification scripts and CI smoke test for airgap install flow. Motivation: previous offline bundles omitted certain distro-specific manifests and lacked checksums which caused bootstrap failures in air-gapped environments and slow operator debugging. This change improves reliability and auditability for private installer customers. Checklist: - [x] Vendor images and tag pinning - [x] Generate checksums.json and manifest allowlist - [x] Helm chart tweaks for containerd / Flatcar - [x] Integration smoke test for offline bundle - [x] Docs (installer/airgap) updated - [x] Release note included Testing: Local bundle generation + tox integration, airgap install e2e smoke in CI (ran against RKE2 1.24 + Flatcar stable), manual validation on customer staging cluster (SUP-982). Rollout notes: Safe to roll forward; new bundles backward compatible with existing installer. If customers hold custom images, installer will still accept an external mirror mapping. Known limitations: Bundle size increased ~120MB due to added images; future work: delta bundles and dedupe across releases. Related: ENG-1742 (airgap reliability), ENG-1819 (installer distro support).

release_notes: Added RKE2 and Flatcar-aware offline bundle generation: vendored images, checksums.json for image verification, smaller allowlist-driven bundles, Helm chart updates for containerd, and airgap smoke test. Administrators should run new bundle verify script before distribution.
notes_for_ops: When producing bundles for customers on Flatcar/containerd, pass --cri=containerd to generate_bundle.sh and provide mirror_map in terraform variable to map images to customer mirror. Recommended to use the packaged checksums.json to validate installation media.
